subject.name: Wind Energy Development Managers
subject.summary: The wind energy development manager corresponds to O*NET11-9199.10, leading or managing the development and evaluation of wind energy business opportunities and covering environmental studies, permit documents, and project proposals, and may also manage construction. It coordinates energy assessment, engineering, and construction, sets scope, schedule, and budget, reviews proposals and technical documents, and takes part in land, power purchase, and grid connection agreement negotiations. Wind farm operations managers and wind turbine service technicians are separated separately; coordinating development does not automatically grant engineering design, on-site electrical work, or administrative approval authority.
